purpose: Use idle authorized GPU 6 to execute eight already-preregistered, currently unstarted phase-1 jobs ahead of their original shards.

scheduling.selection_rule: Select later unstarted jobs from live shards, leaving at least two earlier jobs between the active source job and the first accelerated tag at freeze time.
scheduling.duplicate_guard: Abort before launch if any selected state directory exists; the source queue also skips a tag carrying a live PID or terminal exit code.

claim_limits: This run changes wall-clock scheduling only and contributes no independent scientific condition.
All outputs remain part of the source r02 phase-1 matrix and are counted once by logical job tag.
Any nonzero exit remains preserved and receives coverage only through a fresh exact-retry run.
